title: BrainDead 13
overview:
Experience in real time the movie-like excitement and emotion that Lance humorously unfolds inside the mansion! Truly a new-generation action adventure!!

Young computer whiz Lance answers a repair call at a dark castle, only to meet the disembodied brain of mad scientist Dr. Nero Neurosis and his plan to rule the world. Now trapped inside, Lance has to find a way out while the hunchbacked henchman Fritz chases him with an arsenal of deadly gadgets.

This interactive cartoon plays out as fully animated scenes. Watch for the right moment and press a direction or button to dodge, jump or strike back. Pick the wrong move and Lance meets a comically gruesome end, but with unlimited lives you can try each scene again.

- Choose your own route through the castle's rooms at each crossroads
- Face a cast of bizarre bosses before taking on Fritz and Dr. Neurosis
- Save your progress to memory backup

ランスが屋敷の中でユーモラスに繰り広げる、映画さながらの興奮と感動をリアルタイムに体験しちゃう！まさに新世代のアクションアドベンチャー！！
